root_cause: The code introduced to implement table-directory access (tag == 1) assumed the face is always part of a TTC and that `face_index` is always a valid index into `ttc_header.offsets`. However, `face_index` is also used for non-TTC container formats (e.g., Mac Resource), and no bounds check was added before dereferencing the `offsets` array. The same oversight exists in `sfobjs.c` where a similar condition (`face_index >= face->ttc_header.count`) needed a comment clarifying the context.
findings: In `tt_face_load_any`, when `tag == 1` (table directory access), the code directly uses `face->root.face_index & 0xFFFF` as an index into `face->ttc_header.offsets[]` without first verifying the index is within bounds (`< face->ttc_header.count`).
